Earth Element Magic Spell

Author: qubodup
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/earth-element-magic-spell
File used: earth-element-magic-spell.ogg, renamed from the page's original "Earth Element Magic
Spell.ogg" (the .ogg variant; the page also offers a larger .flac, not used here to keep the
shipped asset small like the game's existing SFX; renamed to drop spaces, matching this repo's
existing asset-filename convention)
Downloaded from: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/Earth%20Element%20Magic%20Spell_3.ogg

License: CC0 (Creative Commons Zero / public domain)
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

No attribution required. Described by the author as "Reversed, tempo-ed-up (800%) boiling
water" -- sounds like roots or ground crumbling.

---

2026-08-09 (issue #151): added earth-element-magic-spell-trimmed.ogg, a derivative of the
file above (Art Sourcing Contract step 3 -- recombine/derive an already-sourced CC0 asset,
not a new download). The original ran 1.886s; the trimmed copy cuts at 1.30s (past the main
rumble, before a small late bump around 1.5s), fading the last 60ms to zero. Same CC0 license
applies to the derivative. Original file kept alongside, untouched, as provenance.
